title: Chapter 337 New Order
content:
Chapter 337 New Order

I don't know how long it took.

A overpass appeared not far in front of Lu Daosheng.

Under the bridge, there is a river full of death, flowing in a rolling manner.

Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows slightly and then walked towards the bridge.

"If you want to cross the bridge, drink the soup first."

As soon as he walked to the front of the bridge, an old woman appeared in front of Lu Daosheng at some point, blocking Lu Daosheng's figure.

At this time, the old woman was holding a bowl of green soup.

Looking at the old woman in front of her, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and slowly poked out his right hand.

"Do you guys think I'm bored?"

Buzz —

A terrifying force suddenly began to condense from Lu Daosheng's hands.

In less than a moment, a deep sphere energy, like a black hole, appeared in Lu Daosheng's hands.

Rumble!

In an instant, everything around began to tremble wildly and buzz.

Obviously, he could not bear the aura emitted by this terrifying energy sphere.

"Wait, wait a moment!"

At this time, a sound came from somewhere.

However, Lu Daosheng could no longer wait.

"It's too late."

The black sphere slowly flew towards the distance.

boom!

The next moment, a huge, unsightly mushroom cloud rose slowly from the depths of the Hall of Reincarnation.

Immediately afterwards, a deafening roar also came into my ears.

The strong fluctuations cleared all the yin energy.

Half of the Hall of Reincarnation turned into ruins in an instant.

Looking into the distance, Lu Daosheng narrowed his eyes slightly.

As Lu Daosheng grabbed his hands in front of him, a embarrassed figure appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

I saw that this man was dressed in a strange and ferocious face, and had a thing similar to a crown on his head.

Do you really think that you are the King of Hell?

"Great, sir, please spare me!"

When the person in front of him saw Lu Daosheng, he quickly beg for mercy.

When Lu Daosheng heard the begging for mercy, he sneered, "I think you are very dissatisfied."

Hearing this, the man's face suddenly changed and he kowtowed quickly, "Accept, I can't accept anyone, but I can't refuse you!"

He was in tears and was still not allowed to cry. Most of his reincarnation palace was gone. How could he still not accept it?

"Pray your true name, can eternal life be seen in the cycle of reincarnation?"

"Haha, are you crazy?"

Lu Daosheng still sneered.

The sentence on the pillar before was written by the guy in front of him.

And by chance, he even saw it.

This was not intentional, Lu Daosheng ate the pillar directly.

"Sir, don't bother with villains, villains are just bragging."

He cried, for fear that Lu Daosheng would give him a dislike.

All I can say is that he has no vision.

If Lu Daosheng had just arrived at the Hall of Reincarnation and he would have come out to greet him immediately, there would have been so many things.

But he couldn't understand. He had no idea what kind of person in front of him was doing when he came to his Reincarnation Palace.

As if he saw what he was thinking, Lu Daosheng patted his shoulder, "Don't be nervous, I'm just here to stroll around."

Wander around? !

The Lord of the Hall of Reincarnation roared in his heart.

I was blown up half of my Reincarnation Palace just by walking around?

At this time, Lu Daosheng also saw the entire Hall of Reincarnation clearly.

All he saw before was just made by the guy in front of him.

The real Hall of Reincarnation is only the one in the distance.

What's even more outrageous is that there is only one person in front of me in the entire Hall of Reincarnation.

The old woman who gave the soup just now was just an illusion.

"Are you managing the entire Hall of Reincarnation alone?"

Lu Daosheng asked.

"Yes, sir, I'm the only one."

"Are you managing the cycle of life and death of sentient beings alone?"

"Uh, that's right."

The Lord of the Hall of Reincarnation hesitated for a while and nodded.

"Take me to see."

Immediately, the Lord of the Hall of Reincarnation took Lu Daosheng toward the hall in the distance.

Lu Daosheng's attack did not affect the hall.

Therefore, the Hall of Reincarnation is still safe and sound.

It took a long time again.

Lu Daosheng slowly walked out of the Hall of Reincarnation.

"Sir, I'll come and have fun next time!"

The Lord of the Hall of Reincarnation enthusiastically sent Lu Daosheng to the door, looking at the direction of Lu Daosheng's departure, his eyes slightly red, as if he was extremely reluctant to leave.

Walking alone to the chaotic void.

There was no trace of color in Lu Daosheng's eyes.

"It's really fun."

"This world is indeed not as simple as it seems."

Afterwards, Lu Daosheng visited the Hall of Cause and Effect and the Hall of Destiny.

Although these two halls were surprised by Lu Daosheng's arrival, they still warmly welcomed him.

When Lu Daosheng saw the cause and effect line of the Cause and Effect Hall and the destiny balance of the Destiny Hall, Lu Daosheng left.

......

Endless stars in the sea.

The magnificent palace still stands quietly here.

No matter how many years have passed, there is still no trace of rust in this palace.

Source Dojo.

A place that makes countless strong people in the world go to.

Lu Daosheng's figure slowly appeared in front of the Yuanji Taoist temple, and then stepped in directly.

"You're here."

As soon as I entered, a vicissitudes of life sounded from the hall.

Immediately afterwards, an old man wearing a star patterned robe slowly emerged from Lu Daosheng.

It's still the same look, without any change.

"You know I'm coming?"

Lu Daosheng was a little surprised.

Upon hearing this, Venerable Yuanji smiled and said, "You have visited all the temples of order I have created. I think the next one is my temple."

"That's how it is."

Lu Daosheng nodded slightly, which was indeed very reasonable.

"Then do you know what I'm coming to find you?"

Hearing this, the smile on the face of Venerable Yuanji disappeared immediately.

"have no idea."

After pondering for a moment, Venerable Yuanji shook his head slightly. Although he had guesses in his heart, he did not dare to say it.

Lu Daosheng is much stronger than him, but he doesn't understand what Lu Daosheng did.

Why does a God always do those mortal things?

Is this a return to nature?

"You created your own order on the basis of this world. Why are you doing this? Just to improve yourself?"

Lu Daosheng looked at the Yuanji Venerable in the distance and spoke calmly.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Venerable Yuanji bowed his head slightly.

"This world is very big. I walked for a long time back then and wanted to pursue the end of the world, but in the end, I seemed to be just standing there forever."

Speaking of this, a trace of memory appeared in the eyes of Venerable Yuanji.

Back then, no matter how he practiced, he could never take the next step.

In desperation, he began to look for a higher world.

But he failed.

Everything entered a cycle.

But he was unwilling to accept this, and then he relied on his unrivaled strength to create a new order.

Cause and effect, destiny, time and space, reincarnation, nothingness.

The Five Great Order Halls are above all sentient beings.

And he is above the five major order halls.

With this, his strength has reached an unprecedented level.

He named this realm - the realm of order.
